method: All 74 PDF pages inspected through rendered 900-pixel-wide page contact sheets. Grayscale compressed viewing copies retained the geometry. All ten pages changed by the final caption, location, date and table corrections were inspected again. Full-color original renderings are retained in page_sheets.
strongest_example: Supplement page 38 retains malformed wording and the internal over|much boundary. Strong is explicitly a score label.
retained_layout: Some algorithm, table and figure page breaks leave white space. No font shrinking or arbitrary page target was imposed.
poppler_math_mapping: Eight main and two supplement control-code glyph mappings were removed only for bbox XML parsing. They correspond to rendered math glyphs, not blank or broken PDF text. Unmodified full-text extraction is retained.
